verdict.rationale: Foreloop's flow proposes tasks from feedback and lets an agent 'fill in the intention, and propose the tasks' (foreloop-docs-10, foreloop-docs-21), implying a review point before work starts, but there is no documented explicit approval/scope-sign-off step, UI, or gate that a PM uses to approve scope prior to execution. missing for 10: explicit scope-approval workflow/UI for PMs, evidence of a gate blocking work until approved, confirmation this occurs before any coding/agent work begins.
